source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
After this unit shoots in your Shooting phase, pick 1 enemy unit, other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**, that this unit's mole grenade launchers hit at least once in that shooting. Until your next Shooting phase starts, the Fire Overwatch Stratagem can't target that unit.

A Mole Grenade token beside that unit is a recommended reminder.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

select.condition: hit by one or more attacks made with a mole grenade launcher

detail.designerNote: use a Mole Grenade token as a reminder
